speaker: Doctor
text:
That pattern of weakness worsening with exertion and improving with rest is highly characteristic of a neuromuscular junction disorder. Given your double vision and limb weakness, are you experiencing any difficulty with swallowing, breathing, or closing your eyes tightly?

REQUEST TEST: Repetitive nerve stimulation and Single-fiber EMG.
REQUEST TEST: Antibody panel for Myasthenia Gravis (Anti-AChR, Anti-MuSK).
